description: Overzicht Hoppinpunten in Vlaanderen is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Departement Mobiliteit en Openbare Werken. De dataset bevat het overzicht van alle geplande en gerealiseerde Hoppinpunten in Vlaanderen zoals bepaald vanuit de 15 vervoerregio's. Een Hoppinpunt is slechts volledig gerealiseerd en operationeel wanneer het voldoet aan de richtlijnen uit het BVR Hoppinpunten, de ontwerpwijzer en de Hoppin-huisstijlgids. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in WMS_SRVC. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
